muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿فالتقطه آل فرعون ليكون لهم عدوا وحزنا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted clause); (التقطه): a past verb, and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (آل): a postponed fāʿil (agent); (فرعون): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ليكون): the lām is of consequence (al-ʿāqiba), and it has been said: of causation (taʿlīl); (يكون): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿التقطه﴾; the noun (ism) of يكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكون﴾; (عدوًّا): the khabar (predicate) of يكون; (حزنًا): conjoined to ﴿عدوًّا﴾.
﴿إن فرعون وهامان وجنودهما كانوا خاطئين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and (فرعون) is its noun; ﴿وهامان وجنودهما﴾: conjoined to فرعون; the clause (كانوا) is the khabar of إن; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and (خاطئين) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وقالت امرأت فرعون قرت عين لي ولك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قالت): conjoined to ﴿فالتقطه آل فرعون﴾; ﴿امرأة فرعون﴾: fāʿil (agent) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قرة عين): the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "هو قرة عين"; (لي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element, two naʿts (adjectives) of قرة [Translator's note: so in the source: "صفتان" (two adjectives) after only لي has been mentioned; presumably لي and لك together]; (لك): conjoined to ﴿لي﴾.
﴿لا تقتلوه عسى أن ينفعنا أو نتخذه ولدا وهم لا يشعرون﴾: (لا) is prohibitive; (تقتلوه): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عسى): a past verb among the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن ينفعنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of عسى, accusative (manṣūb); (أو نتخذه): conjoined to ينفعنا; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and (ولدًا) the second mafʿūl bihi; (وهم): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (لا يشعرون): khabar; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿آل فرعون﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وأصبح فؤاد أم موسى فارغا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (أصبح): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (فؤاد): its noun; (أم موسى): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (فارغًا): its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿وأصبح فؤاد...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن كادت لتبدي به لولا أن ربطنا على قلبها لتكون من المؤمنين﴾: (إن) is lightened from the heavy (inna), inoperative (muhmala); (كادت): a past verb among the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), its noun is latent (mustatir); the lām is the differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); the clause (تبدي): the khabar (predicate) of كاد; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبدي﴾; (لولا): a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); (أن): maṣdariyya, and together with what it governs it is equivalent to a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "لولا ربطنا على قلبها حاصل"; (على قلبها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ربطنا﴾; the apodosis (jawāb) of لولا is omitted, i.e. "لأبدت به"; (لتكون): the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), and (تكون) is an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ربطنا﴾ as well; (من المؤمنين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of تكون.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿وقالت لأخته قصيه فبصرت به عن جنب وهم لا يشعرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قالت): a past verb, and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "هي", i.e. the mother of Moses; (لأخته): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قالت﴾; (قصيه): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the yāʾ is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فبصرت): the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿بصرت﴾; (عن جنب): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of بصرت, i.e. "بصرت به مستخفية كائنة عن جنب", or of the pronoun in به, i.e. "بعيدًا"; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (لا يشعرون): khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وحرمنا عليه المراضع من قبل فقالت هل أدلكم على أهل بيت يكفلونه لكم وهم له ناصحون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (حرمنا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرمنا﴾; (المراضع): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وحرمنا عليه المراضع﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (من قبل): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to ﴿حرمنا﴾; (فقالت): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); (هل): an interrogative particle; (أدلكم): an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا", and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; (على أهل بيت): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أدلكم﴾; the clause (يكفلونه): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أهل بيت﴾; (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكفلونه﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ناصحون﴾; (ناصحون): khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿فرددناه إلى أمه كي تقر عينها ولا تحزن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (رددناه): verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلى أمه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رددناه﴾; (كي): a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تقر): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿كي﴾, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from كي and the verb is in the position of genitive by the omitted lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿رددناه﴾; (ولا تحزن): conjoined to تقر.
﴿ولتعلم أن وعد الله حق ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), and (تعلم): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of تعلم; (أن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (وعد) is its noun, and (حق): its khabar (predicate); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (ولكن أكثرهم): لكن is an abrogating particle, (أكثر) is its noun, and ﴿هم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (لا يعلمون): its khabar.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ولما بلغ أشده واستوى آتيناه حكما وعلما وكذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (لما): temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"), or linking (rābiṭa); (بلغ): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (أشده): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (استوى): conjoined to بلغ; the clause (آتيناه) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); (آتيناه): a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; (حكمًا): second mafʿūl bihi; (علمًا): conjoined to ﴿حكمًا﴾; the clause ﴿ولما بلغ...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "وجزاءً مثلَ ذلك نجزي المحسنين"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن", and ﴿المحسنين﴾ is mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ودخل المدينة على حين غفلة من أهلها﴾: ﴿ودخل المدينة﴾: conjoined to something omitted; (دخل المدينة): verb, latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and an object by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); (على حين غفلة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of المدينة, or of the fāʿil of دخل, i.e. "مختلسًا" (stealthily); (من أهلها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of غفلة.
﴿فوجد فيها رجلين يقتتلان هذا من شيعته وهذا من عدوه﴾: (فوجد): conjoined to دخل; (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿وجد﴾; (رجلين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (يقتتلان): a naʿt of رجلين; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (من شيعته): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is a second naʿt of رجلين, and it has been said a ḥāl; ﴿وهذا من عدوه﴾: conjoined to it.
﴿فاستغاثه الذي من شيعته على الذي من عدوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (استغاثه): a past verb and mafʿūl bihi; (الذي): fāʿil; (من شيعته): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فوكزه موسى فقضى عليه قال هذا من عمل الشيطان إنه عدو مضل مبين﴾: (فوكزه): likewise conjoined; (موسى): fāʿil (agent); (فقضى عليه): conjoined to فوكزه; (قال): a past verb, and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (من عمل الشيطان): khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause (إنه عدو): causal (taʿlīl); (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and (عدو) is its khabar; (مضل): naʿt (adjective); (مبين): a second naʿt.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿قال رب بما أنعمت علي فلن أكون ظهيرا للمجرمين﴾: (بما): the bāʾ is a particle of oath and genitive, and the apodosis of the oath (jawāb al-qasam) is omitted, its implied form being "أقسم بإنعامك علي بالمغفرة لأتوبن"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ of the oath; the fāʾ conjoins to the omitted apodosis; (لن): a particle of negation, accusative-governing and future; (أكون): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا"; (ظهيرًا): its khabar; (للمجرمين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ظهيرًا﴾; and it has been said: the bāʾ and what it governs are attached to an implied ﴿اعصمني﴾, and the fāʾ in ﴿فلن أكون﴾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it is the apodosis of an implied condition.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قال رب إني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي فغفر له إنه هو الغفور الرحيم﴾: ﴿رب﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿ظلمت نفسي﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إن; (فاغفر لي): the fāʾ is a conjunction, (اغفر) is a verb of supplication, and (لي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اغفر﴾; (فغفر له): conjoined; (إن) is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, ﴿هو﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), (الغفور): khabar, and (الرحيم): a second khabar; or ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الغفور الرحيم): two khabars of it, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿فأصبح في المدينة خائفا يترقب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أصبح): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (في المدينة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (خائفًا): the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; or (في المدينة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of أصبح, and (خائفًا): ḥāl; or the verb ﴿أصبح﴾ is complete (tāmm) and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, (في المدينة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it, and (خائفًا) is a ḥāl; the clause (يترقب): a second ḥāl, or a second khabar, or a ḥāl of the pronoun in ﴿خائفًا﴾; the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يترقب is omitted, i.e. "يترقب المكروه" (awaiting what is dreaded).
﴿فإذا الذي استنصره بالأمس يستصرخه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا): of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (الذي): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (استنصره): the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; (بالأمس): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استنصر﴾; the clause (يستصرخه): the khabar of الذي; and what يستصرخه is attached to is omitted, i.e. "على قبطي آخر" (against another Copt).
﴿قال له موسى إنك لغوي مبين﴾: (قال): a past verb; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it; (موسى): fāʿil; (إنك): (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and (غوي مبين): two khabars of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فلما أن أراد أن يبطش بالذي هو عدو لهما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لما): temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa); (أن): connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); (أراد): a past verb; أن and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أراد; (بالذي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبطش﴾; ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); (عدو): khabar (predicate); (لهما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿هو عدو لهما﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قال يا موسى أتريد أن تقتلني كما قتلت نفسا بالأمس﴾: (قال): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (أتريد): the hamza is for interrogation, (تريد) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and أن and what lies within its scope are the mafʿūl bihi of تريد; ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied form being "تقتلني قتلا مثلَ قتلك نفسًا بالأمس"; ﴿قتلت﴾ is verb and fāʿil, (نفسًا) mafʿūl bihi; (بالأمس): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قتلت﴾; the clause ﴿قتلت﴾ is the ṣila of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن تريد إلا أن تكون جبارا في الأرض وما تريد أن تكون من المصلحين﴾: (إن) is negating; (تريد): an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); أن and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar that is the mafʿūl bihi of تريد; (جبارًا): the khabar of تكون; (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿جبارًا﴾; (ما) is negating; (تريد): an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; أن and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar that is the mafʿūl bihi of تريد; ﴿من المصلحين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of تكون.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وجاء رجل من أقصى المدينة يسعى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (جاء رجل): verb and fāʿil (agent); (من أقصى المدينة): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رجل, and the clause (يسعى): a second naʿt, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); or (من أقصى المدينة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جاء﴾, and the clause (يسعى): a naʿt only.
﴿قال يا موسى إن الملأ يأتمرون بك ليقتلوك فاخرج إني لك من الناصحين﴾: (إن الملأ): (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (الملأ) is its noun, and the clause (يأتمرون): the khabar (predicate) of إن; (بك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأتمرون﴾; (ليقتلوك): the lām is of causation (taʿlīliyya), and (يقتلوك) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after it, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يأتمرون﴾; (فاخرج): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause), i.e. "إن سمعت نصيحتي فاخرج" (if you heed my advice, then leave); (إني): (إن) is an abrogating particle and the yāʾ is its noun; (لك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and it has been said: attached to ﴿الناصحين﴾; ﴿من الناصحين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿فخرج منها خائفا يترقب قال رب نجني من القوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خرج﴾; (خائفًا): ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause (يترقب): a second ḥāl, and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يترقب is omitted, i.e. "الشر" (harm), or their catching up with him, and it has been said: he awaited Allah's rescue; (رب): the one addressed (munādā); (نجني): a verb of supplication, and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; (من القوم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجني﴾; (الظالمين): naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿ولما توجه تلقاء مدين قال عسى ربي أن يهديني سواء السبيل﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (لما) is an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna) containing the sense of condition; (توجه): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (تلقاء مدين): an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿توجه﴾; (مدين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), made a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) for being a proper name and feminine; the clause ﴿قال...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); (عسى): an inflexible (jāmid) past verb among the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ); (ربي): its noun; أن and what lies within its scope are its khabar (predicate); (سواء السبيل): a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); the clause ﴿ولما توجه...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ولما ورد ماء مدين وجد عليه أمة من الناس يسقون﴾: (وجد): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وجد﴾; (أمة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من الناس): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمة; the clause (يسقون): a second naʿt, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the mafʿūl bihi of يسقون is omitted since it is known, i.e. "مواشيهم" (their livestock).
﴿ووجد من دونهم امرأتين تذودان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (وجد): conjoined to the first وجد; (من دونهم): a preposition and its genitive noun likewise attached to ﴿وجد﴾; (امرأتين): first mafʿūl bihi; the clause (تذودان): a naʿt of امرأتين. [Translator's note: so in the source, "first mafʿūl bihi", although no second object is named.]
﴿قال ما خطبكما قالتا لا نسقي حتى يصدر الرعاء وأبونا شيخ كبير﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (خطبكما): khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (قالتا): a past verb, the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, given a fatḥa to suit the alif of the dual, and the alif is the fāʿil; the clause (لا نسقي): the object of their saying; (حتى): a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive; (يصدر): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نسقي﴾; (الرعاء): fāʿil; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أبونا): mubtadaʾ; (شيخ): khabar; (كبير): naʿt.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فسقى لهما ثم تولى إلى الظل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted and implied; (سقى): a past verb; (لهما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سقى﴾; the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e. "غنمهما لأجلهما" (their sheep, for their sake); (ثم): a conjunction; (تولى): a past verb; (إلى الظل): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تولى﴾.
﴿فقال رب إني لما أنزلت إلي من خير فقير﴾: (رب): the one addressed (munādā); (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; (لما): the lām is a preposition, and (ما) is an indefinite noun meaning "thing", or a relative noun, i.e. "for whatever thing", or "for that which You sent down"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿فقير﴾; (أنزلت): verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أنزلت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾, or the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; (إلي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنزلت﴾; (من خير): ḥāl (circumstantial); (فقير): the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿فجاءته إحداهما تمشي على استحياء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (إحداهما): fāʿil (agent); the clause (تمشي): a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil; (على استحياء): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil latent in تمشي, i.e. "مستحيية" (bashfully).
﴿قالت إن أبي يدعوك ليجزيك أجر ما سقيت لنا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (أبي) is its noun, and the clause (يدعوك): its khabar (predicate); (ليجزيك): the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), (يجزيك): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يدعوك﴾; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أجر): second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it with what follows is equivalent to a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "أجر سقايتك" (the wage of your watering); (لنا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سقيت﴾.
﴿فلما جاءه وقص عليه القصص قال لا تخف نجوت من القوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (قص): a past verb; (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قص﴾; (القصص): mafʿūl bihi; the clause (قال): has no grammatical position; (لا) is prohibitive; (تخف): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; (نجوت): verb and fāʿil (agent); (من القوم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجوت﴾; ﴿الظالمين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قالت إحداهما يا أبت استأجره﴾: (قالت إحداهما): verb and fāʿil (agent); (يا) is a vocative particle; (أبت): the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, for which the tāʾ is a substitute; (استأجره): imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن خير من استأجرت القوي الأمين﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the command before it; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (خير) is its noun, ﴿من﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause (استأجرت): the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; (القوي): first khabar (predicate); (الأمين): second khabar.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿قال إني أريد أن أنكحك إحدى ابنتي هاتين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause (أريد): its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (أن أنكحك): equivalent to a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أريد; the fāʿil (agent) of أنكحك is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi; (إحدى): second mafʿūl bihi; (ابنتي): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (هاتين): naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ابنتي﴾.
﴿على أن تأجرني ثماني حجج﴾: (على): a preposition that enters upon أن and what follows it, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil or of the mafʿūl, i.e. "مشروطًا علي، أو عليك ذلك" (that being stipulated upon me, or upon you); (تأجرني): an imperfect verb, and the second object of تأجرني is omitted, i.e. "نفسك" (yourself); (ثماني): an adverb (ẓarf) for تأجرني; and it has been said: ثماني is a second object of تأجرني, which requires assuming an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "رعى ثماني حجج" (herding for eight years) [Translator's note: so in the source, "مفعولًا ثانيًا" in the accusative]; (حجج): muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فإن أتممت عشرا فمن عندك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (أتممت): a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (عشرًا): mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb), because it is a nominal clause; (من عندك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "فالتمام من عندك" (then the completion is from you).
﴿وما أريد أن أشق عليك ستجدني إن شاء الله من الصالحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (أريد): an imperfect verb, and a latent fāʿil, its implied form being "أنا"; أن and what lies within its scope are the mafʿūl bihi of أريد; (عليك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أشق﴾; (ستجدني): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت", the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿إن شاء الله﴾: parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), a clause with no grammatical position, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; (من الصالحين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تجدني﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قال ذلك بيني وبينك أيما الأجلين قضيت فلا عدوان علي والله على ما نقول وكيل﴾: (ذلك): mubtadaʾ (subject); (بيني وبينك): its khabar (predicate); (أيما الأجلين): (أي) is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿قضيت﴾, and (ما) is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); and it has been said: ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun meaning "thing", and (الأجلين) is a badal (substitute) of it; (قضيت): verb and fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); (لا) is the lā of generic negation; (عدوان): its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (علي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of لا. (الله): mubtadaʾ. ﴿على ما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿وكيل﴾. The clause ﴿نقول﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (وكيل): the khabar of الله.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿فلما قضى موسى الأجل وسار بأهله آنس من جانب الطور نارا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (لما): temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa); the clause ﴿قضى موسى الأجل﴾ has no grammatical position; (سار): conjoined to قضى; (بأهله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سار﴾; the clause (آنس) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); ﴿من جانب الطور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آنس﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نارًا﴾ and was placed before it; (نارًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قال لأهله امكثوا إني آنست نارا﴾: (لأهله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; the clause (امكثوا): the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿إني﴾ gives the reason for the command to stay; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, the clause (آنست) is its khabar (predicate), and (نارًا) is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لعلي آتيكم منها بخبر أو جذوة من النار لعلكم تصطلون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle of hope (tarajjī), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause (آتيكم) is its khabar; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was a naʿt of خبر; (بخبر): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آتيكم﴾; (أو): a conjunction; (جذوة): conjoined to خبر; (من النار): a naʿt of جذوة; the clause of hope is also a ḥāl; (لعل) is an abrogating particle of hope, ﴿كم﴾ is its noun, and the clause (تصطلون) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿فلما أتاها نودي من شاطئ الواد الأيمن في البقعة المباركة من الشجرة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; the clause (نودي) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); (من شاطئ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نودي﴾; (الواد): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the omitted yāʾ; (الأيمن): a naʿt (adjective) of شاطئ, or a naʿt of الوادي; (في البقعة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الشاطئ; (المباركة): naʿt of البقعة; (من الشجرة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element that is a badal (substitute) of His words ﴿من شاطئ الوادي﴾, a badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl).
﴿أن يا موسى إني أنا الله رب العالمين﴾: (أن): explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause ﴿يا موسى...﴾ is explicative, a clause with no grammatical position; (إني): (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the yāʾ is its noun; (أنا): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الله): the khabar (predicate) of إن, or the khabar of أنا, and the clause is the khabar of إن; (رب العالمين): a naʿt of the Majestic Name, or a badal of it.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وأن ألق عصاك فلما رآها تهتز كأنها جان ولى مدبرا ولم يعقب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿أن ألق...﴾ is conjoined to the one before it. (ألق): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت". (عصاك): mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (فلما): the fāʾ conjoins to something implied that the context requires; ﴿رآها﴾ is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تهتز﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿كأنها جان﴾ is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تهتز; (كأن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and (جان) its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿ولّى﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); the fāʿil of ولى is latent, its implied form being "هو"; ﴿مدبرًا﴾ is a ḥāl; the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause ﴿لم يعقب﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ولّى﴾.
﴿يا موسى أقبل ولا تخف إنك من الآمنين﴾: (أقبل): an imperative verb, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿لا تخف﴾: (لا) is prohibitive, and (تخف) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; (إن) is an abrogating particle, the kāf is its noun, and ﴿من الآمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of إن; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿اسلك يدك في جيبك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء﴾: (اسلك يدك): an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في جيبك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اسلك; (تخرج): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هي"; (بيضاء): ḥāl (circumstantial); (من غير سوء): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بيضاء.
﴿واضمم إليك جناحك من الرهب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (اضمم): an imperative verb, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿إليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اضمم﴾; (جناحك): mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من الرهب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اضمم﴾ as a statement of its reason, i.e. "من أجل الرهب" (because of fear); and it has been said: to ﴿ولّى﴾, i.e. he fled from fright; and it has been said: to ﴿مدبرًا﴾; and it has been said: to an omitted element, i.e. "يسكن من الرهب" (it calms from fear).
﴿فذانك برهانان من ربك إلى فرعون وملئه إنهم كانوا قوما فاسقين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); ﴿ذانك﴾ is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif; (برهانان): khabar (predicate); ﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿برهانان﴾, i.e. "مرسلان من ربك" (sent from your Lord); ﴿إلى فرعون﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿برهانان﴾; ﴿ملئه﴾ is conjoined to فرعون; the clause ﴿إنهم﴾ gives the reason for sending the two proofs; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and the clause (كانوا) is its khabar; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, (قومًا) is its khabar, and (فاسقين) is a naʿt of ﴿قومًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿قال رب إني قتلت منهم نفسا فأخاف أن يقتلون﴾: (رب): the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿قتلت﴾ is its khabar (predicate); (منهم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) and was placed first; ﴿نفسًا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فأخاف﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أخاف): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا"; أن and what lies within its scope are the mafʿūl bihi of أخاف; (يقتلون): accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the first person is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿وأخي هارون هو أفصح مني لسانا فأرسله معي ردءا يصدقني إني أخاف أن يكذبون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أخي): mubtadaʾ (subject); (هارون): badal (substitute), or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, (أفصح) khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of أخي; (مني): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أفصح﴾; (لسانًا): tamyīz (specification); (فأرسله): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); (أرسله): a verb of supplication, its fāʿil (agent) is "أنت", and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (معي): an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿أرسله﴾, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ردءًا): ḥāl (circumstantial); (يصدقني): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ردءًا﴾, or a ḥāl of the object of أرسله; the clause ﴿إني أخاف﴾ is causal (taʿlīl); (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause (أخاف) is the khabar of إن; أن and what lies within its scope are the mafʿūl bihi of أخاف.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿قال سنشد عضدك بأخيك ونجعل لكما سلطانا﴾: the clause ﴿سنشد﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the fāʿil (agent) of نشد is "نحن"; (عضدك): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بأخيك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نشد﴾; ﴿ونجعل﴾ is conjoined to سنشد; ﴿لكما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element that is the second object of ﴿نجعل﴾; (سلطانًا): the first object of نجعل.
﴿فلا يصلون إليكما بآياتنا أنتما ومن اتبعكما الغالبون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; (يصلون): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿إليكما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يصلون﴾; ﴿بآياتنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element, i.e. "اذهبا بآياتنا" (go, both of you, with Our signs), or to ﴿نجعل﴾, or to ﴿يصلون﴾, or to ﴿سلطانًا﴾, i.e. "نسلطكما بآياتنا" (We give you both authority by Our signs), or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (أنتما): mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun conjoined to أنتما, and the clause ﴿اتبعكما﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (الغالبون): the khabar (predicate) of أنتما.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿فلما جاءهم موسى بآياتنا بينات قالوا ما هذا إلا سحر مفترى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (لما): an adverbial temporal particle (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa); ﴿جاءهم موسى﴾: verb, mafʿūl (object) and fāʿil (agent); (بآياتنا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (بينات): ḥāl; the clause (قالوا): the apodosis (jawāb) of لما; (ما) is negating; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (سحر): khabar (predicate); (مفترى): naʿt (adjective).
﴿وما سمعنا بهذا في آبائنا الأولين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (سمعنا): verb and fāʿil; (بهذا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سمعنا﴾; (في آبائنا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿هذا﴾; (الأولين): naʿt of ﴿آبائنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿وقال موسى ربي أعلم بمن جاء بالهدى من عنده﴾: (ربي): mubtadaʾ (subject); (أعلم): its khabar (predicate); (بمن): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause ﴿جاء بالهدى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿من عنده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ومن تكون له عاقبة الدار إنه لا يفلح الظالمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (مَن): conjoined to the first مَن; (تكون): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of تكون; ﴿عاقبة الدار﴾: its postponed noun; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يفلح الظالمون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿وقال فرعون يا أيها الملأ ما علمت لكم من إله غيري﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿قال فرعون﴾: a past verb and a nominative (marfūʿ) fāʿil (agent); (يا) is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), made indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh); (الملأ): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; (ما) is negating; ﴿علمت﴾: verb and fāʿil; (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (من) is a connective particle (ḥarf ṣila, i.e. redundant); ﴿إله﴾ is genitive (majrūr) in form by من, accusative (manṣūb) in position, because it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (غيري): a naʿt of ﴿إله﴾.
﴿فأوقد لي يا هامان على الطين فاجعل لي صرحا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); (أوقد): an imperative verb, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿لي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أوقد﴾; (يا) is a vocative particle; ﴿هامان﴾ is a singular proper-name munādā; ﴿على الطين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أوقد﴾; ﴿فاجعل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أوقد﴾; ﴿لي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element that is the second object of ﴿اجعل﴾; (صرحًا): first object.
﴿لعلي أطلع إلى إله موسى وإني لأظنه من الكاذبين﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) of hope (tarajjī), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿أطلع﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿إلى إله موسى﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أطلع﴾; (وإني): the wāw is a conjunction, (إن) is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the clause (أظنه) is its khabar; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من الكاذبين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second object.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿واستكبر هو وجنوده في الأرض بغير الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (استكبر): a past verb; ﴿هو﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of استكبر, because with a latent pronoun of the third person it is permissible to make it overt, or it is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) fāʿil; (جنوده): conjoined to هو; (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استكبر﴾; ﴿بغير الحق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of استكبر, i.e. "متلبسين بغير الحق" (being clothed in what is other than the truth).
﴿وظنوا أنهم إلينا لا يرجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ظنوا): conjoined to استكبر; أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of ظنوا; (إلينا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يرجعون﴾; (لا) is negating, and the clause ﴿لا يرجعون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿فأخذناه وجنوده فنبذناهم في اليم فانظر كيف كان عاقبة الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿أخذناه﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (جنوده): conjoined to the hāʾ in أخذناه, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); (فنبذناهم): conjoined to فأخذناه; (في اليم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نبذناهم﴾; (فانظر): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause), and (انظر) is an imperative verb; (كيف): a fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; (عاقبة الظالمين): its postponed noun, and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿وجعلناهم أئمة يدعون إلى النار ويوم القيامة لا ينصرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿جعلناهم﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أئمة): second mafʿūl bihi; the clause (يدعون): a naʿt (adjective) of أئمة; ﴿إلى النار﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يدعون﴾. ﴿ويوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and (يوم): an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿ينصرون﴾; (لا) is negating; (ينصرون): an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿وأتبعناهم في هذه الدنيا لعنة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أتبعناهم): verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في هذه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (الدنيا): badal (substitute) of ﴿هذه﴾; (لعنة): second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ويوم القيامة هم من المقبوحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (يوم): an accusative (manṣūb) adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to an omitted verb indicated by the context, its implied form being "قُبحوا" (they were made abhorrent); it is also valid to attach it to the passive participle ﴿المقبوحين﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من المقبوحين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب من بعد ما أهلكنا القرون الأولى﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the lām is in answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (آتينا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (موسى): first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الكتاب): second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿ولقد آتينا موسى...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آتينا﴾; (ما) is maṣdariyya; (أهلكنا): verb and fāʿil; (القرون): mafʿūl bihi; (الأولى): naʿt (adjective).
﴿بصائر للناس وهدى ورحمة لعلهم يتذكرون﴾: (بصائر): ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب, on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "ذا بصائر" (possessing insights), or by way of hyperbole (mubālagha), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of بصائر; ﴿وهدى ورحمة﴾: conjoined to بصائر; (لعلهم يتذكرون): (لعل) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) of hope (tarajjī), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and the clause (يتذكرون) is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿وما كنت بجانب الغربي إذ قضينا إلى موسى الأمر وما كنت من الشاهدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (ما) is negating; (كنتَ): (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; ﴿بجانب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾; (الغربي): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; (إذ): an adverb (ẓarf) for the past, attached to the omitted khabar to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; (قضينا): verb and fāʿil (agent), and the clause قضينا is genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; (الأمر): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw: a conjunction, and the clause ﴿وما كنت...﴾ is conjoined, resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (ما): negating; (كنت): (كان) is an incomplete past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; (من الشاهدين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of كنت.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿ولكنا أنشأنا قرونا فتطاول عليهم العمر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لكن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause (أنشأنا) is its khabar (predicate); (نا) is the fāʿil (agent); (قرونًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فتطاول): conjoined to أنشأنا; ﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تطاول﴾; (العمر): fāʿil.
﴿وما كنت ثاويا في أهل مدين تتلو عليهم آياتنا ولكنا كنا مرسلين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (كنت): (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and (ثاويًا) its khabar; ﴿في أهل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ثاويًا﴾; (مدين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿تتلو﴾ is in the position of accusative as a second khabar of كنت, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in ﴿ثاويًا﴾; (ولكنا): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction, (لكن) is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause (كنا) is its khabar; (كان) is an incomplete past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and (مرسلين) its khabar.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وما كنت بجانب الطور إذ نادينا ولكن رحمة من ربك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; ﴿بجانب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت; (الطور): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿إذ﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) for the past, attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿كنت﴾ to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause ﴿نادينا﴾ is in the position of genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لكن﴾ is an inoperative (muhmal) particle of rectification (istidrāk); ﴿رحمة﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رحمة﴾.
﴿لتنذر قوما ما أتاهم من نذير من قبلك لعلهم يتذكرون﴾: (لتنذر): the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), and (تنذر) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted ﴿أرسلناك﴾; (قومًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ما أتاهم﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿قومًا﴾; (ما) is negating; (أتاهم): a past verb and mafʿūl bihi; (من) is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; (نذير): genitive in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the fāʿil (agent); (من قبلك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of نذير; (لعل) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) of hope (tarajjī), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and the clause (يتذكرون) its khabar.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ولولا أن تصيبهم مصيبة بما قدمت أيديهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لولا): a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); أن and what lies within its scope are a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, and its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, its implied form being "لما أرسلنا رسولًا" (We would not have sent a messenger); (مصيبة): fāʿil (agent); (بما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تصيبهم﴾; the clause ﴿قدمت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فيقولوا ربنا لولا أرسلت إلينا رسولا فنتبع آياتك ونكون من المؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (يقولوا): conjoined to أن تصيبهم; (ربنا): an annexed munādā (the one addressed); (لولا): of urging (taḥḍīḍiyya), meaning "هلا" (why not); ﴿أرسلت﴾: verb and fāʿil; (إلينا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أرسلت﴾; (رسولًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فنتبع): the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and (نتبع) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar taken from the preceding speech, i.e. "هلا ثمة إرسال فاتباع الآيات" (why is there not a sending, and so a following of the signs). The fāʿil of نتبع is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; (آياتك): mafʿūl bihi; (نكون): conjoined to نتبع; the noun of نكون is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; ﴿من المؤمنين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿فلما جاءهم الحق من عندنا قالوا لولا أوتي مثل ما أوتي موسى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لما): temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa); ﴿جاءهم الحق﴾: a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a postponed fāʿil (agent); (من عندنا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءهم﴾; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of لما; (لولا) is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); ﴿أوتي﴾ is a past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿مثل﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أوتي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (موسى): nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿أولم يكفروا بما أوتي موسى من قبل﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; (يكفروا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; (بما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكفروا﴾; the clause ﴿أوتي موسى﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (من قبل): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكفروا﴾, or to ﴿أوتي﴾.
﴿قالوا سحران تظاهرا وقالوا إنا بكل كافرون﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. (سحران): the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "هما ساحران" [Translator's note: so in the source, "ساحران" (two sorcerers), the reading of some readers, while the quoted text has ﴿سحران﴾ (two sorceries)]. The clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause (تظاهرا) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سحران﴾; (وقالوا): the wāw is a conjunction, and (قالوا): a past verb, and the wāw is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (إنا): (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (بكل): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كافرون﴾; (كافرون): the khabar of إن, and the clause is the object of the saying.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قل فأتوا بكتاب من عند الله هو أهدى منهما أتبعه إن كنتم صادقين﴾: (قل): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition; the imperative verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (بكتاب): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فأتوا﴾; ﴿من عند﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective), and the Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); (أهدى): khabar (predicate); (منهما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أهدى﴾, and the clause is a second naʿt of كتاب; ﴿أتبعه﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the command (jawāb al-amr), the fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إن) is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is its noun, and (صادقين) its khabar; the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "فأتوا".

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿فإن لم يستجيبوا لك فاعلم أنما يتبعون أهواءهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; (يستجيبوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (لك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستجيبوا﴾; the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اعلم): an imperative verb; (أنما): a restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يتبعون): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (أهواءهم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أنما and what lies within its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلم.
﴿ومن أضل ممن اتبع هواه بغير هدى من الله إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation and disapproval, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أضل): its khabar (predicate); (ممن): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أضل﴾; the clause ﴿اتبع هواه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿بغير هدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿هدى﴾; the clause ﴿إن الله﴾ gives the reason for what preceded; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Majestic Name is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿ولقد وصلنا لهم القول لعلهم يتذكرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) or a conjunction; the lām is in answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (وصلنا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and ﴿نا﴾: an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وصلنا﴾; (القول): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ولقد وصلنا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or conjoined; (لعل) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) of hope (tarajjī), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿يتذكرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿الذين آتيناهم الكتاب من قبله هم به يؤمنون﴾: (الذين): a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (آتيناهم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿آتيناهم﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الكتاب): second mafʿūl bihi; (من قبله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿هم﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ; ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يؤمنون﴾; the clause (يؤمنون) is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause ﴿هم به يؤمنون﴾ is the khabar of الذين.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وإذا يتلى عليهم قالوا آمنا به﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb (ẓarf) of the future containing the sense of condition; the clause (يتلى) is in the position of genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; (يتلى): an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu); (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتلى﴾; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", referring to the Quran; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); the clause ﴿آمنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آمنا﴾.
﴿إنه الحق من ربنا إنا كنا من قبله مسلمين﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and (الحق) is the khabar (predicate) of إن; (من ربنا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إنا كنا ...﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is its khabar; (من قبله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; (مسلمين): the khabar of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿أولئك يؤتون أجرهم مرتين بما صبروا﴾: (أولئك): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (يؤتون): khabar (predicate); (يؤتون): an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (أجرهم): second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مرتين): a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ; it stands in for the maṣdar (verbal noun) because it is its number; ﴿بما صبروا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤتون﴾; the bāʾ is a preposition of causation (sababiyya), and (ما) is maṣdariyya, i.e. "بسبب صبرهم" (because of their patience).
﴿ويدرءون بالحسنة السيئة ومما رزقناهم ينفقون﴾: ﴿ويدرءون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يؤتون﴾, and the wāw in ﴿يدرءون﴾ is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (بالحسنة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدرءون﴾; (السيئة): mafʿūl bihi; (مما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ينفقون﴾; the clause (رزقناهم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿ينفقون﴾ is conjoined to يدرءون.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿وإذا سمعوا اللغو أعرضوا عنه وقالوا لنا أعمالنا ولكم أعمالكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb (ẓarf) of the future containing the sense of condition; the clause (سمعوا) is genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; (اللغو): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (أعرضوا) has no grammatical position; (عنه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعرضوا﴾; (قالوا): conjoined to أعرضوا; ﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (أعمالنا): a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ولكم أعمالكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿سلام عليكم لا نبتغي الجاهلين﴾: (سلام): mubtadaʾ; ﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause ﴿لا نبتغي الجاهلين﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لا) is negating; (نبتغي): an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; (الجاهلين): mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿إنك لا تهدي من أحببت ولكن الله يهدي من يشاء وهو أعلم بالمهتدين﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا تهدي﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; (مَن): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (أحببت) is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿ولكن الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لكن) is an abrogating particle, the kāf is its noun [Translator's note: so in the source, apparently carried over from إنك; the noun of لكن here is the Majestic Name الله], and the clause ﴿يهدي﴾ is its khabar; ﴿مَن﴾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), (أعلم) khabar, and (بالمهتدين) a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿وقالوا إن نتبع الهدى معك نتخطف من أرضنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قالوا): a past verb, and the wāw is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (إن) is conditional; (نتبع): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; (الهدى): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (معك): an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (نتخطف): the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being "نحن"; (من أرضنا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نتخطف﴾.
﴿أولم نمكن لهم حرما آمنا يجبى إليه ثمرات كل شيء رزقا من لدنا ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw conjoins to something omitted that the context requires; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; (نمكن): an imperfect verb, jussive by لم, the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن"; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نمكن﴾; (حرمًا): mafʿūl bihi; (آمنًا): naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿يجبى﴾ is a second naʿt of ﴿حرمًا﴾; (إليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يجبى﴾; ﴿ثمرات﴾ is nāʾib fāʿil; ﴿كل شيء﴾: (كل) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (شيء) is likewise muḍāf ilayhi; (رزقًا): a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of His words يجبى, because "being gathered" (al-jibāya) and "provision" (al-rizq) have one meaning; and it has been said: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and it has been said: a ḥāl of الثمرات, as they are specified by annexation; ﴿من لدنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿رزقًا﴾. ﴿ولكن أكثرهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, (لكن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (أكثرهم) is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وكم أهلكنا من قرية بطرت معيشتها﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (كم) is enunciative (khabariyya, "how many"), a fronted object of ﴿أهلكنا﴾; ﴿من قرية﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكنا﴾, and it is the tamyīz (specification) of the enunciative كم; the clause ﴿بطرت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of قرية; (معيشتها): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the basis that بطرت is made to contain the meaning of a transitive verb, i.e. "كفرت معيشتها" (it was ungrateful for its livelihood); the clause ﴿وكم أهلكنا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فتلك مساكنهم لم تسكن من بعدهم إلا قليلا وكنا نحن الوارثين﴾: (فتلك): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (تلك) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (مساكنهم): khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿لم تسكن﴾ is a second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), the governor of which is the sense of the demonstrative; (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (قليلًا): an adverb (ẓarf), i.e. "إلا وقتًا قليلًا" (except for a little time), so the exception is from the adverb; or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "لم تسكن من ضروب السكن إلا سكنًا قليلا" (they were not inhabited with any kind of inhabiting except a little inhabiting), so the exception is from the maṣdar (verbal noun); the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿كنا﴾: (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (نحن): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of كان; (الوارثين): the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿وما كان ربك مهلك القرى حتى يبعث في أمها رسولا يتلو عليهم آياتنا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; (ما) is negating; ﴿كان ربك﴾: (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, (ربك) its noun, and (مهلك) its khabar (predicate); (القرى): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl) and genitive; (يبعث): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مهلك﴾; (في أمها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبعث﴾; ﴿رسولًا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يتلو﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رسولًا﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يتلو﴾; (آياتنا): mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وما كنا مهلكي القرى إلا وأهلها ظالمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (كان) is an incomplete past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and ﴿مهلكي﴾ its khabar; (القرى): muḍāf ilayhi; (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أهلها): mubtadaʾ (subject); (ظالمون): khabar; the clause is circumstantial, and the exception is emptied (mufarragh) from the most general of states, i.e. "We would not destroy the people of the towns, after We had sent to their mother-town a messenger calling them to the truth and guiding them to it, in any state whatsoever except the state of their being wrongdoers by giving the lie to Our messenger and disbelieving in Our signs".

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وما أوتيتم من شيء فمتاع الحياة الدنيا وزينتها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position; (ما) is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أوتيتم): a past verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من شيء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) explaining ﴿ما﴾; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); (متاع): the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ; (الحياة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الدنيا): naʿt (adjective); (زينتها): conjoined to متاع; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the verb and the apodosis are the khabar of ما.
﴿وما عند الله خير وأبقى أفلا تعقلون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (ما): a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; (عند): an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi; (خير): khabar; (أبقى): conjoined to خير; the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted that the context requires; (لا) is negating; (تعقلون): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿أفمن وعدناه وعدا حسنا فهو لاقيه كمن متعناه متاع الحياة الدنيا ثم هو يوم القيامة من المحضرين﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿وعدناه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿وعدناه﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وعدًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (حسنًا): naʿt (adjective); the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ; (لاقيه): khabar (predicate); ﴿كمن﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿مَن﴾, and ﴿مَن﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿متعناه﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿متاع﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); ﴿الحياة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿الدنيا﴾ is a naʿt of الحياة; (ثم): a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ; ﴿يوم القيامة﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) المحضرين, and (القيامة) is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من المحضرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿ويوم يناديهم فيقول أين شركائي الذين كنتم تزعمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember); the clause ﴿يناديهم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فيقول﴾: conjoined to يناديهم. ﴿أين﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (شركائي): a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شركائي﴾; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position. (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تزعمون﴾ is its khabar; the two objects of تزعمون are omitted, their implied form being ﴿تزعمونهم شركائي﴾; the clause ﴿أين شركائي﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قال الذين حق عليهم القول ربنا هؤلاء الذين أغوينا أغويناهم كما غوينا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿قال الذين﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿حق عليهم ...﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿القول﴾: fāʿil; (ربنا): an annexed munādā (the one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; (هؤلاء): mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين): a relative noun in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿أغوينا﴾ is a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ the fāʿil, and the clause ﴿أغوينا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, i.e. "هؤلاء الذين أغويناهم". ﴿أغويناهم﴾: a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ the fāʿil, the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm the sign of the plural; ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), that maṣdar belonging to the reflexive (muṭāwiʿ) of the verb mentioned, the implied form of the speech being "أغويناهم فغَوَوا غَيًّا مثلَ غَيِّنا" (we led them astray, so they went astray with a straying like ours); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿غوينا﴾ is a past verb and ﴿نا﴾ the fāʿil; the clause ﴿غوينا﴾ is the ṣila of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and what it entered upon is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أغويناهم كما غوينا﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿تبرأنا إليك ما كانوا إيانا يعبدون﴾: the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿تبرأنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil; (إليك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبرأنا﴾; (ما) is negating; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; (إيانا): a fronted object of ﴿يعبدون﴾; the clause ﴿يعبدون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿وقيل ادعوا شركاءكم فدعوهم فلم يستجيبوا لهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قيل): a past verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هذا القول" (this saying); (ادعوا): an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); (شركاءكم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فدعوهم): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (دعوهم) is a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ is a conjunction; (يستجيبوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستجيبوا﴾.
﴿ورأوا العذاب لو أنهم كانوا يهتدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿رأوا العذاب﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; أن and what follows it are the fāʿil of an omitted verb, i.e. "لو ثبت كونهم مهتدين في الدنيا لما رأوا العذاب في الآخرة" (had their being rightly guided in this world been established, they would not have seen the punishment in the Hereafter). ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and the clause (كانوا) is its khabar (predicate); (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause (يهتدون) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿ويوم يناديهم فيقول ماذا أجبتم المرسلين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يوم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يوم﴾ in His words, Exalted is He, ﴿ويوم يناديهم فيقول أين شركائي﴾; the clause ﴿يناديهم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فيقول﴾: conjoined to يناديهم; (ماذا): an interrogative noun in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition (nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); (أجبتم): a past verb, and the tāʾ is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (المرسلين): mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أجبتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿فعميت عليهم الأنباء يومئذ فهم لا يتساءلون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (عميت): a past verb; (الأنباء): fāʿil (agent); (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عميت﴾; ﴿يومئذ﴾: (يوم) is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to ﴿عميت﴾, and (إذٍ) is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being "يوم إذ يناديهم فيقول ماذا أجبتم المرسلين". ﴿فهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (هم): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿لا يتساءلون﴾: khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿فأما من تاب وآمن وعمل صالحا فعسى أن يكون من المفلحين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (أما): a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); ﴿مَن﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿تاب﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿عمل﴾: verb and latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); ﴿صالحًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "عمل عملًا صالحًا" (he did righteous work). The fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); (عسى): an inflexible (jāmid) past verb among the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), its noun is latent, its implied form being "هو", and أن and what lies within its scope are its khabar (predicate); ﴿من المفلحين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of يكون; the clause ﴿فأما من تاب...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وربك يخلق ما يشاء ويختار ما كان لهم الخيرة سبحان الله وتعالى عما يشركون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿ربك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يخلق﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿ويختار﴾ is conjoined to يخلق; the clause ﴿وربك يخلق...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar of كان; ﴿الخيرة﴾ is its postponed noun; ﴿سبحان﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, and the Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وتعالى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and (تعالى) a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); ﴿عما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تعالى﴾; the clause ﴿يشركون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿وربك يعلم ما تكن صدورهم وما يعلنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (رب): mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (يعلم): khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿تُكِنُّ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (صدورهم): fāʿil (agent); ﴿وما﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿ما﴾, and the clause ﴿يعلنون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿وهو الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الله) the khabar (predicate).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: badal (substitute) of the position of لا and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal of the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar. The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is a second khabar.
﴿له الحمد في الأولى والآخرة وله الحكم وإليه ترجعون﴾: ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar; (الحمد): a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is a third khabar; ﴿في الأولى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿الآخرة﴾ is conjoined to الأولى; ﴿وله الحكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿له الحمد﴾; ﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ترجعون﴾; (ترجعون): an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم إن جعل الله عليكم الليل سرمدا إلى يوم القيامة﴾: (قل): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the hamza is for interrogation; (رأيتم): verb and fāʿil; the first object of ﴿أرأيتم﴾ is a latent pronoun referring to ﴿الليل﴾, the two verbs ﴿رأيتم﴾ and ﴿جعل﴾ having contended (tanāzuʿ) for ﴿الليل﴾, and ﴿جعل﴾ was made to govern it because of its nearness to it; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿جعل الله عليكم﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the Majestic Name is the fāʿil; ﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿الليل﴾ is the first object of جعل, and ﴿سرمدًا﴾ its second object; ﴿إلى يوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سرمدًا﴾; (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
﴿من إله غير الله يأتيكم بضياء أفلا تسمعون﴾: the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of أرأيتم; ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إله﴾ is khabar (predicate); (غير): naʿt of إله, and the Majestic Name: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿يأتيكم﴾ is a second naʿt of ﴿إله﴾; ﴿بضياء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأتيكم﴾. ﴿أفلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted and implied, (لا) is negating, and ﴿تسمعون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم إن جعل الله عليكم النهار سرمدا إلى يوم القيامة﴾: (قل): an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the hamza is for interrogation; (رأيتم): verb and fāʿil; the first object of ﴿أرأيتم﴾ is a latent pronoun referring to ﴿النهار﴾, the two verbs ﴿رأيتم﴾ and ﴿جعل﴾ having contended (tanāzuʿ) for ﴿النهار﴾, and ﴿جعل﴾ was made to govern it because of its nearness to it; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿جعل الله عليكم﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the Majestic Name is the fāʿil; ﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿النهار﴾ is the first object of جعل, and ﴿سرمدًا﴾ its second object; ﴿إلى يوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سرمدًا﴾; (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
﴿من إله غير الله يأتيكم بليل تسكنون فيه أفلا تبصرون﴾: the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of ﴿أرأيتم﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إله﴾ is khabar (predicate); (غير): naʿt of إله, and the Majestic Name: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿يأتيكم﴾ is a second naʿt of ﴿إله﴾; ﴿بليل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأتيكم﴾; ﴿تسكنون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (فيه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تسكنون﴾; the clause ﴿تسكنون﴾ is a naʿt of ليل. ﴿أفلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted and implied, (لا) is negating, and ﴿تبصرون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
