muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿ومن رحمته جعل لكم الليل والنهار لتسكنوا فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون﴾: ﴿من رحمته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿جعل لكم﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) by assuming ﴿أن﴾, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (جعل): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element that is the second object of جعل; (الليل): the first object of جعل; (النهار): conjoined to الليل; (لتسكنوا): the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), and (تسكنوا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جعل﴾; the wāw is the fāʿil; (فيه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تسكنوا﴾; ﴿لتبتغوا من فضله﴾ is conjoined to لتسكنوا. ﴿ولعلكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, (لعل) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) of hope (tarajjī), ﴿كم﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تشكرون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿ويوم يناديهم فيقول أين شركائي الذين كنتم تزعمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember); the clause ﴿يناديهم﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فيقول﴾: conjoined to يناديهم. ﴿أين﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (شركائي): a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شركائي﴾; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position. (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿تزعمون﴾ is its khabar; the two objects of تزعمون are omitted, their implied form being ﴿تزعمونهم شركائي﴾; the clause ﴿أين شركائي﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ونزعنا من كل أمة شهيدا فقلنا هاتوا برهانكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿نزعنا﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿من كل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نزعنا﴾; ﴿أمة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (شهيدًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فقلنا﴾ is conjoined to نزعنا; the clause (هاتوا) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿هاتوا﴾ is an imperative verb, and the wāw is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (برهانكم): mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فعلموا أن الحق لله وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (علموا): a past verb, and the wāw is in the position of nominative as fāʿil; أن and what lies within its scope stand in place of the two objects of علموا; (أن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (الحق) is its noun, and ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of أن; (ضل): a past verb; ﴿عنهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ضل﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause ﴿يفترون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿إن قارون كان من قوم موسى﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (قارون) is its noun, and the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the noun of كان is latent (mustatir), referring to Qārūn; ﴿من قوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of كان; ﴿موسى﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فبغى عليهم وآتيناه من الكنوز ما إن مفاتحه لتنوء بالعصبة أولي القوة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (بغى): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent, referring to Qārūn; ﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿بغى﴾; ﴿آتيناه﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من الكنوز﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آتيناه﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿آتيناه﴾; (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿مفاتحه﴾ is the noun of إن; ﴿لتنوء﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ﴿تنوء﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "هي", and the clause is the khabar of إن; the clause ﴿إن مفاتحه لتنوء بالعصبة﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿بالعصبة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تنوء﴾; ﴿أولي﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of العصبة, and ﴿القوة﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إذ قال له قومه لا تفرح إن الله لا يحب الفرحين﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to an omitted element, its implied form being "فأظهر التفاخر والفرح بما أوتي من الكنوز" (so he displayed boasting and exultation at the treasures he had been given); the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; (قومه): fāʿil, and the hāʾ: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿لا تفرح﴾: the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (لا) is prohibitive, and (تفرح) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the fāʿil of تفرح is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; the clause ﴿إن الله ...﴾ gives the reason for the prohibition; (إن) is an abrogating particle, the Majestic Name is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يحب الفرحين﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿وابتغ فيما آتاك الله الدار الآخرة ولا تنس نصيبك من الدنيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ابتغ): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); ﴿في﴾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya or relative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "متقلبًا فيما آتاك" (moving about in what He has given you), and the meaning of ﴿في﴾ here is causation (sababiyya); the clause ﴿آتاك الله﴾ has no grammatical position; ﴿آتاك الله﴾: a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Majestic Name a postponed fāʿil; ﴿الدار﴾ is the object of ﴿ابتغ﴾, and (الآخرة) a naʿt (adjective) of الدار; ﴿لا تنس﴾: (لا) is prohibitive, and (تنس) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "أنت"; (نصيبك): mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من الدنيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element as a ḥāl.
﴿وأحسن كما أحسن الله إليك ولا تبغ الفساد في الأرض إن الله لا يحب المفسدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أحسن﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied form being "أحسنْ إحسانًا مثل إحسان الله إليك" (do good with a doing-good like Allah's doing good to you); ﴿أحسن﴾ is a past verb, and the Majestic Name is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿إليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أحسن﴾; ﴿لا تبغ الفساد﴾ is conjoined to what preceded; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿الفساد﴾, or to ﴿تبغ﴾; the clause ﴿إن الله ...﴾ gives the reason for the preceding prohibition; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Majestic Name is its noun, and the clause (لا يحب المفسدين) is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿قال إنما أوتيته على علم عندي﴾: the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position; (إنما): a restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (أوتيته): a past verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على علم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil in أوتيته; (عندي): an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿علم﴾, i.e. "إنما أوتيته حال كوني متصفًا بالعلم الذي عندي" (I was only given it while being characterised by the knowledge that I have). The yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أولم يعلم أن الله قد أهلك من قبله من القرون من هو أشد منه قوة وأكثر جمعا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; the wāw conjoins to something implied that the hamza entered upon; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; (يعلم): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun; أن and what lies within its scope stand in place of the two objects of يعلم; (أن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Majestic Name is its noun, and the clause ﴿قد أهلك﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the fāʿil of أهلك is a latent pronoun; ﴿من قبله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أهلك﴾; ﴿من القرون﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿مَن هو أشد﴾, placed before it; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أهلك﴾; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (أشد) khabar; the clause ﴿هو أشد﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿قوة﴾ is a tamyīz (specification); ﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أشد﴾; ﴿وأكثر جمعًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أشد منه قوة﴾.
﴿ولا يسأل عن ذنوبهم المجرمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; ﴿يسأل﴾ is an imperfect verb in the passive; ﴿عن ذنوبهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسأل﴾; ﴿المجرمون﴾ is nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿فخرج على قومه في زينته﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿على قومه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خرج﴾; ﴿في زينته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿قال الذين يريدون الحياة الدنيا يا ليت لنا مثل ما أوتي قارون إنه لذو حظ عظيم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿قال الذين﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يريدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (الحياة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الدنيا): a naʿt (adjective) of الحياة; (يا): a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā) is omitted; ﴿ليت﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) of wishing (tamannī); ﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of ليت; ﴿مثل﴾ is its postponed noun; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أوتي﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أوتي﴾ is a past verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and (قارون) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (إن) is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), ﴿ذو﴾ is its khabar, ﴿حظ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and (عظيم) a naʿt of ﴿حظ﴾.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿وقال الذين أوتوا العلم ويلكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿قال الذين﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أوتوا العلم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿ويلكم﴾ is the object of an omitted verb.
﴿ثواب الله خير لمن آمن وعمل صالحا ولا يلقاها إلا الصابرون﴾: ﴿ثواب﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the Majestic Name muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (خير) khabar (predicate); ﴿لمن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خير﴾; the clause ﴿آمن﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿وعمل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿آمن﴾; ﴿صالحا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "عمل عملًا صالحًا" (he did righteous work). The wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; ﴿يلقاها﴾ is an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu); ﴿ها﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿الصابرون﴾ is a postponed nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is the first object.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿فخسفنا به وبداره الأرض﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); ﴿خسفنا﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خسفنا﴾; ﴿وبداره﴾ is conjoined to ﴿به﴾; ﴿الأرض﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فما كان له من فئة ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان من المنتصرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (كان): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿فئة﴾ is genitive (majrūr) in form by من, nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the noun of كان; the clause ﴿ينصرونه﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of فئة; ﴿من دون﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of فئة, and the Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is an incomplete past verb, its noun latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", referring to Qārūn; ﴿من المنتصرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿وأصبح الذين تمنوا مكانه بالأمس يقولون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿أصبح﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿الذين﴾ its noun; the clause ﴿تمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿مكانه﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بالأمس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمنوا﴾; the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; or أصبح is complete (tāmma), الذين is the fāʿil (agent), and the clause يقولون is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "قائلين" (saying).
﴿ويكأن الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء من عباده ويقدر﴾: ﴿وي﴾ is a verbal noun with imperfect meaning (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ), meaning "I marvel"; (كأن) is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), one of the sisters of inna, and here it is for statement and certainty; the Majestic Name is its noun, and the clause ﴿يبسط الرزق﴾ is the khabar of كأن; (الرزق): mafʿūl bihi; ﴿لمن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبسط﴾; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿من عباده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿ويقدر﴾ is conjoined to يبسط.
﴿لولا أن من الله علينا لخسف بنا﴾: (لولا) is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), containing the sense of condition; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن﴾ and what lies within its scope is nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar is necessarily omitted; ﴿من الله﴾: verb and fāʿil; ﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿من﴾; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of لولا; the clause ﴿خسف بنا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); the object of ﴿خسف﴾ is omitted, i.e. "الأرض" (the earth).
﴿ويكأنه لا يفلح الكافرون﴾: (وي) is a verbal noun with imperfect meaning (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ), meaning "I marvel"; (كأن) is a particle resembling the verb, one of the sisters of inna, and here it is for statement and certainty; the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يفلح﴾ is its khabar; ﴿الكافرون﴾ is the fāʿil of يفلح.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿تلك الدار الآخرة نجعلها للذين لا يريدون علوا في الأرض ولا فسادا والعاقبة للمتقين﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿تلك﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الدار﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; ﴿الآخرة﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of الدار; the clause ﴿نجعلها﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of تلك; ﴿للذين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نجعلها﴾, as its second object; the clause ﴿لا يريدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿علوًّا﴾ is the object of يريدون; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿علوًّا﴾; ﴿ولا فسادًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿علوًّا﴾; (العاقبة): mubtadaʾ; ﴿للمتقين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿من جاء بالحسنة فله خير منها﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾ is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (جاء): a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿بالحسنة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاء﴾; the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is a nominal clause; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿خير﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خير﴾; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the verb and the apodosis together are the khabar of من.
﴿ومن جاء بالسيئة فلا يجزى الذين عملوا السيئات إلا ما كانوا يعملون﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿يجزى﴾ is an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu); ﴿الذين﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿عملوا السيئات﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ما): the second object of ﴿يجزى﴾; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿إن الذي فرض عليك القرآن لرادك إلى معاد﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (الذي) is its noun, and the clause ﴿فرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿عليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فرض﴾; ﴿القرآن﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿رادك﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation; ﴿إلى معاد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿راد﴾.
﴿قل ربي أعلم من جاء بالهدى ومن هو في ضلال مبين﴾: ﴿ربي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the yāʾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and ﴿أعلم﴾ its khabar; ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause ﴿جاء﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بالهدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جاء﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿مَن﴾; ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿في ضلال﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; ﴿مبين﴾ is its naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿وما كنت ترجو أن يلقى إليك الكتاب إلا رحمة من ربك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; ﴿كنت﴾: (كان) is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿ترجو﴾ is its khabar (predicate); أن and what lies within its scope are the object of ترجو; ﴿إليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يلقى﴾; ﴿الكتاب﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) meaning "لكن" (but), for rectification (istidrāk); ﴿رحمة﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); ﴿من ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة.
﴿فلا تكونن ظهيرا للكافرين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); (لا) is prohibitive; ﴿تكونن﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis (nūn al-tawkīd al-thaqīla); ﴿ظهيرًا﴾ is the khabar of تكونن; ﴿للكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ظهيرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿ولا يصدنك عن آيات الله بعد إذ أنزلت إليك﴾: conjoined to what preceded; (لا) is prohibitive; (يصدنك): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescents, and the ḍamma remained as an indication of it; its original form is "يصدونّك"; ﴿عن آيات الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصدنك﴾, and the Majestic Name is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to ﴿يصدنك﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, i.e. "بعد وقتِ إنزالها" (after the time of their being sent down); the clause ﴿أنزلت﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; ﴿إليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنزلت﴾.
﴿وادع إلى ربك ولا تكونن من المشركين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ادع﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿إلى ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ادع﴾; (لا) is prohibitive; ﴿تكونن﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive by ﴿لا﴾; its noun is latent; ﴿من المشركين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿ولا تدع مع الله إلها آخر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تدع): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿مع الله﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدع﴾; ﴿إلهًا﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (آخر) a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إلهًا﴾.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: badal (substitute) of the position of لا and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal of the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿كل شيء هالك إلا وجهه له الحكم وإليه ترجعون﴾: (كل): mubtadaʾ; (شيء): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (هالك): the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; (إلا): a particle of exception (istithnāʾ); ﴿وجهه﴾ is the excepted (mustathnā); ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (الحكم): a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ترجعون﴾; (ترجعون): an imperfect verb in the passive (mabnī li-mā lam yusamma fāʿiluhu), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
